end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one group of ten and some more.
Used sticks, bundles, and equations such as 10 + 3 = 13.
Saanvi connected a bundle with ten sticks after discussion.
They continued to mix up the digit 1 in 13 with one single object.
Teach-back was not passed; the confusion was still present at the last turn.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making a group of ten and adding loose sticks, including 10 + 3 = 13. Using bundles and sticks helped them notice that one bundle contains ten, but the mix-up between the digit 1 and one object was still present at the end. At home, please make a bundle of 10 small objects and add 1–9 loose objects, saying the matching number sentence together; keep it brief while they are rested.
